reservation_policy: Reservations are estimates, never process caps. Five phases serial; all completed objects retained. Fresh headroom and shared admission ownership required.
disk_reservation_basis: 5 * actual 1334351109B complete retained inventory =6671755545B, with16GiB scheduling reservation for instrumented generation, snapshots, linker temporaries and logs; not maximum output and never used to kill a job.
RAM_reservation_basis: 16GiB scheduling reservation exceeds twice actual7438536704B sampled aggregate peak for same serial2worker geometry; estimate only, unknown future peaks monitored with192GB live availability; no MemoryMax or AS limit.
